correctness.rationale: Both the frozen covariance identities and the repaired multivariate claim are correct. For fixed a,b the coefficient-to-evaluations map has image M={(u,v)∈R²:v−u∈gR}. Containment follows by congruence of every monomial modulo g; the constant column spans the diagonal, and subtracting that column times a_i from coordinate column i yields (0,b_i−a_i), together spanning the entire difference ideal gR. Fibers are equal, so (0,0) has mass 1/|M|=g/m² and the first coordinate has uniform marginal. This remains true on the diagonal g=m, and when g=1 the pair is uniform on R². Expanding g−1 via totients and summing over ordered pairs gives exactly the A_d(u)B_d(u) covariance, including A∩B. On the full grid the class-product sum is d^n(m/d)^{2n}. This gives the repaired all-modulus and prime-power variance and the exact examples 6 and 19 for m=4 and 6 at n=2. The repaired main theorem has n≥2 and keeps the same free coefficient and arbitrary-support hypotheses; its univariate commentary is not part of novelty. The original proof's stray reference to 'proper' divisors is not retained: the divisor m is included.
residual_risks: The optional replay is the unchanged frozen verify.py under Python 3. Its recorded counts are 5998 polynomials across ten finite ensembles and 2754 pair checks; some ensembles are univariate comparison cases. Of the 116 modulus/dimension checks, direct lattice summation is restricted to m^n≤100000. The proper-subset computation checks a variance, not every mixed subset covariance; the general proof supplies the exact mixed statement.

evidence: Jain–Moon–Wu's proved field generating functions have a degree threshold and do not cover composite residue rings. Their Conjecture 5.7 has a mean part and a one-variable variance statement for d>1, with stabilization separate. Monagan–Tuncer is all-modulus but one-variable. Caruso works with distributions/densities of actual p-adic roots in extensions; Evans counts actual p-adic zeros of random systems.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Monic or nonmonic one-variable congruence counting and p-adic Haar theorems about exact zeros are not general theorems specializing to the repaired finite-image and arbitrary-region law. The single-evaluation expectation is elementary and is not a novelty claim.

originality.rationale: PASS is for the repaired multivariate spatial claim only. In the frozen submission, the univariate variance and its connection to Conjecture 5.7 are foregrounded as a contribution without the directly overlapping Monagan–Tuncer result. Their Theorem 1 and its proof give the same arbitrary-modulus univariate gcd kernel and variance for monic polynomials; the same pair-count proof works for prescribed higher coefficients when the constant and linear terms are free. Thus the frozen univariate contribution is not accepted as original. The replacement explicitly credits it and limits the claim to the joint multi-coordinate kernel and regional divisor-scale decomposition, for which the inspected closest statements supply no covering higher-dimensional theorem.
residual_risks: No absolute priority claim. The separately formatted journal version of Jain–Moon–Wu was not read as full text; the arXiv alternate was inspected and that distinction is preserved. Older arbitrary-dimensional congruence-evaluation identities could exist under other terminology. The two exact univariate overlaps are credited, not dismissed on chronology or monicity alone.

value.rationale: The repaired result resolves a natural finite-ring second-moment question for arbitrary sampling regions and every composite modulus, rather than merely reproducing a known univariate variance. It determines which joint congruence scales create zero-count dependence, gives exact covariance for intersecting as well as disjoint regions, and specializes to the full-grid multivariate variance without expanding the higher-degree ensemble. The precision is independently useful for uncertainty in counts on residue-restricted regions, even though the totient sum and the single-evaluation expectation are classical or elementary.
residual_risks: No utility claim depends on higher moments, stabilization, positive association, or applied prediction. The new value is confined to the multivariate second-moment structure and exact region counts.
